voice.speaker: athena-as-mentes
voice.caption: Wearing the shape of Mentes, Athena waits at the palace threshold with her spear upright.

voice.speaker: the-suitors-1
voice.caption: Dice strike the floor; cups are filled; the suitors never look toward the gate.

voice.speaker: telemachus
voice.caption: Telemachus sees the unattended stranger and crosses the hall, ashamed of his own house.

voice.speaker: telemachus
voice.caption: Welcome, stranger. You are kindly come to our house; give me your spear. Eat first, and afterward tell me what you need, but come, away from this noise.

keys.beat: Athena arrives at Odysseus's palace disguised as Mentes and waits at the outer gate.
The suitors gamble and feast while servants prepare wine, tables, and meat.
Telemachus notices the unattended stranger and crosses the hall in shame.
He greets her, takes her spear, and leads her away from the suitors' noise.
